summary: Sandbach United are putting the finishing touches on their preparations for the new 26/27 season, which kicks off in just one week! The Ramblers have welcomed several new signings and one returning player to bolster the squad, and they're sporting three brand new kits this year. After a recent friendly loss to St Helens where the opposition made the most of their chances, the team is ready to get the campaign underway and push for promotion.
